title: Figure Split Tiles
description: Add a general mechanism so a figure disposition can split into many crop-tiles with independent positions across arrangements (reveal.js auto-animate). Demonstrate in projektetage: catalogue figure splits into 3x5 grid, taken apart/scaled down, partial focus.
summary:
Fixed Bauteilkatalog → Bauteilarten tiles popping instead of morphing.

Root cause: reveal.js `data-id` was on the inner `.presentation-figure-tile-frame` (always 100% of its parent) while slide position lived on the canvas-framed `.presentation-interactive-disposition` wrapper. Auto-animate had nothing to interpolate for layout — tiles vanished and reappeared.

Fix: per-tile interactive placements set `revealMorphId` (`tileMorphId`) on the wrapper; inner tile frames omit `data-id` when the wrapper owns the anchor. CSS `overflow: hidden` on morph wrappers. Regression test asserts four wrapper pairs across catalogue→focus slides. Renderer: 56 tests pass.
